title: Oozy Spicy Moroccan Almonds Amlou
description: A traditional Moroccan dish with a spicy twist, featuring hot chilli powder and char-grilled almonds in a rich amlou sauce.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Spread the almonds on a baking sheet and char-grill in the oven for 10 minutes.
In a saucepan, combine the honey, argan oil, hot chilli powder, ground cinnamon, ground ginger, and sea salt.
Heat the saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture is smooth and warm.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the orange blossom water.
Add the char-grilled almonds to the saucepan and stir until they are well coated with the amlou sauce.
Transfer the almonds to a serving dish and let them cool to room temperature.
Serve the oozy spicy Moroccan almonds amlou warm or at room temperature.
